system.description: By meditating upon this silky white stone for one week and spending one Willpower, the bearer casts her gaze across the Beyond--that transcendent realm that contains such things as cannot be, have never existed and never will come to pass--in order to better understand that which is. Treat this scrying as a vision-quest (Compass of Celestial Directions: the Wyld, pp. 139-141). Using the stone requires only one day of meditation within the landscape of any of Oramus' Third Circle souls.
